title: Reducing Safety Margin
statement: Decrease the safety margin to allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially reducing the turning radius and improving maneuverability.
mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot can approach the obstacles more closely, which can help in making tighter turns and avoiding stalling.
